It also provides investment products remote banking bancassurance TPE affiliation AVA business travel allowance and MoneyGram services as well as international services and credit cards. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E.
Description: Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E. operates as an integrated poultry company in Egypt. It operates through Food Poultry and Other segments. The company produces breeds and fattens chicks. It also involved in production of animal feed and fertilized eggs. In addition the company operates feed plants and poultry slaughterhouse. Further the company offers grandparents parents hatcheries broilers and processing poultry products. It sells its products primarily under the Koki and Koki Gold names. The company serves restaurants and five-star hotels as well as other users of feed live chicken chicken meat and other value-added chicken products. It also exports its products. Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: National Finance Company SAOG
Description: National Finance Company SAOG offers financial products and services to individuals small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and corporate entities in the Sultanate of Oman. The company provides corporate deposits; and new and used vehicles used vehicles consumer durables equipment and warehouse financing services as well as working capital debt factoring guarantee and sale and lease back services as well as green finance service. It operates through its branches in the Sultanate of Oman. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Mutandis SCA
Description: Mutandis SCA produces and sells seafood in Morocco Africa Europe and the Middle East. It is also involved in the production and marketing of detergents and care products the production and sales of fruit juices and water in bottles and fishing and processing activities. Mutandis SCA was founded in 2008 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc
Description: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc provides various commercial banking products and services primarily to multinational companies financial institutions individuals small businesses partnerships and commercial entities in Nigeria. It operates through Retail Banking Commercial Banking Institutional Banking Corporate & Investment Banking Non-Interest Banking and Special Purpose Vehicle segments. The company offers savings and current accounts; investment products; personal loans; cards; e-channels; business accounts loan products business advisory and business digital solutions for SMEs; credit services to large scale enterprises; recurring discounted certificate fixed and call deposits; and importers financing invoice discount facility letter of credit and overdraft services. It operates a network of branches and cash centers. Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Gelecek Varlik Yönetimi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Gelecek Varlik Yönetimi AS operates as a financial institution in Turkey. It provides banking savings deposits insurance fund loans other financial institution and consultancy and intermediary services. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Gelecek Varlik Yönetimi Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Fiba Holding Anonim Sirketi.

Name: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A.
Description: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. captures produces bottles and markets still and carbonated natural mineral waters in Morocco. It is involved in the manufacture and sale of preforms as well as bottling and marketing of table water. The company offers its products under the Sidi Ali Oulmès Aïn Atlas Vitalya Bahia Purifya Glass' Orangina Fifa of Sainte Luce and DIAM brands. Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited
Description: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited together with its subsidiaries provides banking and other related services in Kenya Tanzania Uganda and Burundi. The company offers current savings salary accounts and fixed deposits; mortgage and term loans; and overdrafts hire purchase credit guarantee scheme insurance premium financing leasing and trade finance as well as debit and credit cards. Name: Herfy Food Services Company
Description: Herfy Food Services Company establishes operates and franchises restaurants in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Restaurants Meat Factory and Bakeries. It operates restaurants under the HERFY name. The company also produces and sells frozen products bakery and pastry products through bakeries and bakery shops under the Herfy Bakeries/Dokka name; and meat products. In addition it provides cooked meals; catering services; purchases and sells land for constructing buildings; and owns uses maintains and leases warehouses and refrigerators for storing food. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacturing wholesale or retail purchase import and sale of processed or unprocessed feeds in Turkey. Name: Victory Supermarket Chain Ltd
Description: Victory Supermarket Chain Ltd operates supermarkets in Israel. The company sells kosher products. Victory Supermarket Chain Ltd also sells its products through online. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Yavne Israel.

Name: Arabian Pipes Company
Description: Arabian Pipes Company engages in the production and marketing of steel tubes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in bending shaping and threading pipes outside and inside pipes and accessories. In addition the company engages in trading of pipes and fittings; and extension of pipeline activity. Further it manufactures pipes hoses and plastic pipes as well as shapes hollow iron and steel. The company exports its products to the North Africa Middle East and Gulf countries. Arabian Pipes Company was founded in 1991 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. operates as a life and medical insurance company in Qatar. It operates through two segments: Medical and Life. The company offers group and individual and group medical insurance; retirement and child insurance plans; and senior citizens and visitors mandatory health insurance. It also underwrites reinsurance products in the GCC region and internationally. QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2011 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Ser Educacional S.A.

Description: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides tourism services in Brazil and internationally. CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Santo André Brazil.

Name: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment
Description: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment engages in manufacturing and distributing fresh and processed poultry and poultry related products under the Entaj brand. The company offers poultry table eggs live birds red meat and cold store products. It is also involved in the egg and broiler chicken production; support activities for animal production; production of chilled and frozen meat; preservation and preparation of meat and meat products in various ways such as drying and canning; production of egg products and eggshells; preparation and processing of egg products; and wholesale of dairy egg frozen meat and poultry products. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Riyadh Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment operates as a subsidiary of Arabian Agricultural Services Co. Ltd.

Name: Saudi Company for Hardware SACO
Description: Saudi Company for Hardware SACO engages in the retail and wholesale of household and office supplies and appliances construction tools and equipment and electrical tools and hardware in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates in two segments Sales and Services and Logistic Services. It offers freight forwarding transportation and contract logistics as well as delivery installation and maintenance services. The company also provides port handling trans-shipment warehouse management and maintenance and custom clearance services. It sells its products online. Saudi Company for Hardware SACO was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E.
Description: Taaleem Management Services Company offers private higher education and skills-based learning services in Egypt. It operates Nahda University Badya University and Memphis University. Name: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A.
Description: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development production and sale of veterinary drugs vaccines and other products for production and companion animals primarily in Brazil. Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Cravinhos Brazil.

It offers solutions for printed circuit boards electronic manufacturing services assembly wire and harness systems plastic injection and molding cable manufacturing and ICT. Name: Ibnsina Pharma
Description: Ibnsina Pharma operates as a pharmaceutical distributor in Egypt. The company offers pharmaceutical and cosmetics products to private and public-sector customers including retail chains independent pharmacies wholesalers hospitals and healthcare institutions. It also provides warehousing and logistic services for its suppliers; marketing solutions; importation and packaging services; and market research and analysis services as well as value added services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Nascon Allied Industries Plc
Description: Nascon Allied Industries Plc manufactures and sells refined edible and grade salt in Nigeria. The company operates through Salt and Seasoning segments. It offers table pure dried and vacuum tannery butter and edible and non-edible industrial salt; and spices comprising stew mix and curry powder as well as seasoning cubes tomato paste and vegetable oil. The company sells its products directly to distributors who redistribute to wholesalers confectioners supermarkets and retailers under the Dangote and Dan Q brand names. Nascon Allied Industries Plc was formerly known as NASCON Industries Plc and changed its name to Nascon Allied Industries Plc in July 2015. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Ikeja Nigeria. Nascon Allied Industries Plc operates as a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.

It operates through Auto Parts and Home segments. The company offers gray and ductile iron and aluminum components for automotive systems including brakes engines and chassis. The company sells its products under the Draxton and Cinsa brands. Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1928 and is based in Saltillo Mexico.

Name: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S.
Description: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. manufactures and sells vehicle tires and related products in North America South America Europe the Middle East Africa and Asia. It is involved in the manufacturing of industrial cloths transmission belts v-belts rubber hoses and rubber and plastic products; industrial single cord with industrial fabrics in the structure of the material; heavy denier fiber and connection fabrics; and the processing and marketing of guide cloths and other rubber reinforcement materials. Name: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG
Description: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in milling wheat and other cereals in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in four segments: Flour Mill Feed Mill Bakery and Others. Name: Tabuk Cement Company
Description: Tabuk Cement Company manufactures and sells cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers ordinary Portland cement blended hydraulic cement and sulphate resisting cements. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Tabuk the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail of mother-baby products in Turkey and internationally. It sells its products through its ebebek brand name through retail and e-commerce channels. Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Cherry Trading Company
Description: Cherry Trading Company engages in the wholesale and retail trade in new and used private cars. The company operates through the Lease Rental and Used Car Sale segments.
