Description: Balady Poultry Company together with its subsidiaries produces poultry products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia other GCC countries and internationally. The company offers whole and marinated chicken; and chicken parts including gizzards hearts breasts thighs whole chicken feet wings mix chicken pieces liver feet and legs as well as chicken fillet. It also engages in the rearing and production of laying boiler breeders and operation of its hatcheries; operation of slaughterhouses for the slaughter and preparation of poultry rabbit and bird meat; land transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods; wholesale of feed and non-pharmaceutical feed additives; and production of chilled and frozen meat poultry rabbits and birds as well as poultry feed. In addition the company is involved in the production of fertilizers from organic materials and potassium fertilizers; construction and renovation of residential and non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals and hotels; pharmaceutical sales agency; and construction of government buildings. The company was formerly known as Balady Poultry Trading Company. Balady Poultry Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Khamis Mushait the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme
Description: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme engages in the design manufacture and sale of aluminum alloy profiles for building and industrial needs in Tunisia. The company also offers swing carpentry sliding carpentry facades and sun breezes armored carpentry inner wall bodyguard roller shutter and other products.  It exports its products. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Mégrine Tunisia.

Name: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG engages in marketing and distributing of petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. The company is also involved in blending of lubricants. In addition it operates Shell service stations; Shell Select shops which offers beverages fresh food and localized offers; Shell Café; and Shell GO+ for digital promotions. Further the company offers shell fuel cards engine oils and lubricants for motorists; and industrial lubricants for industries including auto and truck dealers aviation construction fleet manufacturing marine metals mining and power. The company was formerly known as Shell Marketing (Oman) Ltd. and changed its name to Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG in June 1997. Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1958 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG engages in the marketing and distribution of petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through Retail Commercial Aviation Lubricants and Non-Fuel Services segments. The company offers gasoline diesel jet fuel and kerosene; retail commercial aviation and marine fuels; lubricants comprising engine gear and hydraulic oils as well as specialty lubricants brake fluids engine coolants and greases; fuel cards; autofill RFID; Fuely a fuel delivery service; bunkering services for vessels; and non-fuel related services. It also provides smart tags; Al Maha PLUS app; car wash services; and oil and lube change services for cars as well as operates fuel stations convenience stores and service centers. Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Mpact Limited
Description: Mpact Limited engages in the paper and plastic packaging and recycling business in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Paper and Plastics segments. The company offers recycled-based packaging and industrial paper such as containerboard and carton board and other materials; corrugated packaging products; bags; and sacks as well as plastic packaging solutions. It serves packaging converters fruit producers FMCG companies and quick restaurant sectors as well as food beverage personal care home care pharmaceutical agricultural and retail markets. The company is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company
Description: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company engages in the production and sale of oil products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers fuel and transformer oils paraffin wax and derivatives gasoline and diesel neutral and special mineral oils liquefied petroleum gas naphtha and wax distillates as well as engages in the maximization of gas oil with low sulphur and pour point oil loading and blending and crude oil refining activities. It is also involved in importing exporting marketing selling and trading its products other petroleum products and supplies as well as engages in the warehouse leasing business. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Invicta Holdings Limited
Description: Invicta Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the distribution of engineering components and consumables in South Africa the Rest of Africa Europe and Asia. It operates in Replacement Parts for Industrial Equipment; Replacement Parts for Auto and Agri; Capital Equipment and Related Services; and Replacement Parts for Earthmoving Equipment. The company offers technical services including on-site installation maintenance work breakdown repair condition monitoring failure analysis design engineering and manufacturing services; engineering consumables such as bearings seals and gaskets power transmissions light and heavy materials handling fasteners geared and electric drives and motors; and fluid technology products and solutions comprising hydraulic pneumatic valves pumps filtration hose fittings and lubrication. It also supplies tools and equipment cutting welding lifting personal protective equipment locks and machine tools; imported and local vibrator motors tensioning and suspension systems; and vibrating equipment and material handling solutions. In addition the company manufactures and supplies heavy-duty belting components and imported conveyer belting to the industry. Further it supplies automotive and agricultural after-market replacement parts and kits; forklifts off-road dump trucks and related spare parts; earthmoving and materials-handling equipment; after-market replacement spare parts ground engaging tools and undercarriage parts for earthmoving equipment; aftermarket heavy-duty diesel engine parts for industrial and agricultural machinery; and heavy machinery parts and diesel engine components used for excavators bulldozers wheel loaders motor graders trucks trailers power generation sets and marine engines. Additionally it provides technical support and value-added assembly services. Invicta Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC
Description: Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC engages in the production of palm oil primarily in Ghana. It produces palm oil and palm kernel oil. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Takoradi Ghana. Benso Oil Palm Plantation PLC is a subsidiary of Wilmar Africa Limited.

Name: Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC
Description: Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC manufactures distributes and sells spirits alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages and other ancillary products. It offers its products under the Guinness Malta Guinness Johnnie Walker Star and Smirnoff Ice brands. Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Kumasi Ghana. Guinness Ghana Breweries PLC is a subsidiary of Diageo plc.

Name: UAC of Nigeria PLC
Description: UAC of Nigeria PLC operates in the animal feeds and other edibles packaged food and beverages and quick service restaurant business in Nigeria. It operates through Edibles & Feed Paints Packaged Food & Beverages and Quick Service Restaurants (QSR) segments. The Edibles & Feed segment engages in the manufacture and sale of livestock feeds and edible oil. The Paints segment manufactures and sells paint products and other decoratives. The Packaged Food & Beverages segment manufactures and sells bottled water snacks and ice-cream. The QSR segment is involved in the making and sale of snacks and meals. The company operates and franchises Mr Biggs’ and Debonairs Pizza chain of restaurants. It also engages in property development; building and operation maintenance for commercial and residential properties; operation of hotel and conference rooms; and provision of logistics services such as warehousing short-and medium-haul transportation and haulage services. UAC of Nigeria PLC was founded in 1879 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Custodian Investment Plc
Description: Custodian Investment Plc through its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services in Nigeria. It operates through Non-Life Business Life Business Pension Administration Property Development and Management and Trustees and Others segments. The Non-Life Business segment offers engineering aviation marine and motor liability oil and energy fire and property insurance for individual and corporate customers. The Life Business segment provides a range of life insurance products for individual and group including annuity endowment and investment-oriented products and insurance products with discretionary participatory features (DPF). The Pension Administration segment is involved in the administration and management of the retirement benefits of members. The Property Development and Management segment engages in the acquisition development sale and management of various commercial residential hospitality and retail property assets. The Trustees and Others segment includes trustee management corporate services investment and property management. The company offers general insurance products such as auto travel home event personal accident and other insurance products; and life insurance products including savings and investment endowment protection annuity and other products as well as group life and group credit life insurance products. The company was formerly known as Custodian and Allied Insurance Limited. Custodian Investment Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Societe Tunisienne de Verreries
Description: Societe Tunisienne de Verreries engages in the manufacture and marketing of glass and ancillary products in Tunisia and internationally. Societe Tunisienne de Verreries was founded in 1963 and is based in Zaghouan Tunisia. Societe Tunisienne de Verreries is a subsidiary of Compagnie Financiere d'Investissement CFI.

Name: Renaissance Services SAOG
Description: Renaissance Services SAOG together with its subsidiaries operates as an accommodation services solutions and integrated facilities management company in the Sultanate of Oman and rest of the Middle East. The company offers turnkey and other contract services including accommodation solutions facilities management and establishment contract catering operations and maintenance training cleaning and waste management services. It is also involved in the ownership building and operation of permanent accommodation for contractors; and investment in companies and properties as well as general trading and related activities. The company serves healthcare energy defense education utilities and other sectors. Renaissance Services SAOG was founded in 1996 and is based in Muttrah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Disway S.A.
Description: Disway S.A. distributes IT and telecom equipment products in Morocco and internationally. The company offers laptops desktop PC and all in one computers; printers scanners point of sale terminals tracers copiers faxes and consumables; tablets smartphones connected objects headphones and earphones; multimedia products; and accessories. It also provides various solutions including serves networks data centers storages backups software and video surveillance. In addition it provides solar products such as solar panels pumping and accessories; on and off grid solutions; and protective equipment. Further the company offers logistics services; manages stocks; processes orders; and engages in packing and co-packing drop shipping assembly inventory and reporting services. It serves gaming industry. It sells its products under HP ASUS and LENOVO brands. Disway S.A. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Al Jouf Cement Company
Description: Al Jouf Cement Company engages in production and sale of cement in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It provides sulfate-resistant cement ordinary Portland cement Super 20 cement and finishing cement. The company also engages in the provision of marketing services; land transport of goods; and import export wholesale and retail trade of cement products. Its products are used in various application such as various types of concrete structures and foundations civil and construction projects reinforced concrete works pipes and cement brick factories as well as finishing works. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: A'Saffa Foods SAOG
Description: A'Saffa Foods SAOG manufactures and distributes poultry meat in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers fresh frozen and processed chicken. The company was formerly known as ASaffa Poultry Farms SAOG and changed its name to A'Saffa Foods SAOG in April 2010. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Alf Meem Yaa for Medical Supplies and Equipment Company
Description: Alf Meem Yaa for Medical Supplies and Equipment Company engages in the wholesale and retail trade of medical supplies for the aesthetic market in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers Teoxane a range of injectable hyaluronic acid-based dermal fillers designed to treat wrinkles; Deka medical laser systems and therapies; Magellan an autologous concentration system that delivers concentrated platelets and cells at the point of care; and Euromi medical dermatological and aesthetic surgery equipment. It also provides perfumes cosmetics orthotic devices decorative soaps incense veterinary medicines and medical equipment. Alf Meem Yaa for Medical Supplies and Equipment Company was founded in 2005 and is based in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Cashbuild Limited
Description: Cashbuild Limited engages in the retailing of building materials and associated products in South Africa Botswana Eswatini Lesotho Namibia Zambia and Malawi. It operates through Cashbuild P&L Hardware Cashbuild Common Monetary Operations and Cashbuild Non-Common Monetary Operations segments. The company offers builder hand and garden tools; safety equipment and workwear tanks field toilets drain covers and wheel barrows; and aggregates plastic sheeting and steel products. It also provides brickwork; concrete; cement; electrical and bathroom and kitchen products; doors putty and windows; roofing and ceiling products; tools and hardware; inverters petrol generators lighting and gas solutions; soft drinks and snacks; and outdoor and decorative products. It serves contractors homebuilders and improvers farmers traders and other customers. The company operates through the Cashbuild model and P&L Hardware stores. Cashbuild Limited was founded in 1978 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi manages and processes fruits and vegetables in Turkey. The company offers concentrate puree concentrate puree deionized concentrate frozen IQF natural peel oils natural fruit FTNF direct pressed fruit juices dried seeds consumer products and fresh fruits products. It offers its products under Fruit Drops Get One and Absolutely brand names. The company exports its products. Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E)
Description: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E) provides various corporate retail and investment banking services in Egypt. It offers savings current interest bearing and investment accounts; certificates of deposit; and time deposits. The company provides secured personal auto used cars auto durable goods education syndicated and mortgage loans; revolving overdrafts; loans for small and medium sized businesses; working capital and trade financing; project finance; loans for doctors; and pharmacists lending services. In addition it offers Islamic banking cash management foreign exchange treasury bills and bonds payroll fund margin lending e-statement and online banking services as well as debit credit and internet cards. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of polyurethane system in Turkey. It offers polyurethane unit sole polyurethane slipper system polyurethane safety shoe sole polyurethane boot polyurethane insole polyester polyol and polymeric polyester polyol systems; release agents; and liquid color master batch systems. The company provides sandwich polyurethane polyurethane pipe insulation polyurethane spray foam polyurethane polyurea systems polyurethane rubber binder system and shutter and sectional doors polyurethane systems; elastomers; release agents; polyester polyols; integral foam filter foam and sound insulation systems; and office furniture foam wood imitation viscoelastic integral foam polyester polyol systems for flame laminations. In addition it offers commercial and domestic refrigerator systems cold storage room refrigerator container systems and boiler and solar panel systems; EVA compounds thermoplastic polyurethane polyurethane gels and stress ball systems; and polyols for rigid polyurethane and foam and CASE Applications. Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and supplies French fries in Turkey. The company offers potato wedges spicy coated potato wedges crinkle potato spicy coated crinkle potato coated cage fries and spicy coated cage fries. It also provides frozen cheese stick and onion rings. It supplies its products to quick service restaurants. It also exports to China Brazil Iraq and United Arab Emirates. Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: BH Bank Société anonyme
Description: BH Bank Société anonyme a financial institution provides various products and services to public customers in Tunisia. It offers bank deposits credit granting foreign exchange and payment services. The company provides wealth advisory and management financial management and financial engineering services as well as facilitates the creation development and restructuring of companies and takes stakes in the capital of existing or newly created companies. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A.
Description: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. provides industrial infrastructure integrity engineering and inspection services in the petrochemical pulp and paper steel offshore naval mining and infrastructure sectors in Brazil. The company provides access solutions including scaffolding UpPriner LinkDeck Rope access and Web PrinerDeck; mechanical testing chemical analysis metallographic analysis corrosion testing field solutions procedure and welder qualification and failure analysis; execution of injected piles micro-anchoring anchored retaining walls soil nailing shotcrete soil treatment and load testing; pressurized habitat solutions; non-destructive testing inspection of equipment and facilities welding engineering advanced engineering materials engineering and laboratory services training and consulting inspection software and tank inspection services. It also offers Vivax Insertion camera Rovver X and Camera manhole zoom STV-3; conventional removable and reusable PFP hot and cold insulation and thermoplastic coating; industrial park; inspection and RBI finite element analysis engine thermal jackets computational fluid dynamics and fracture mechanics. In addition the company provides CIPP Point repair Steam curing process pressurized networks and UV Line curing process; and resin injection gallery plugging structural repair and reinforcement waterproofing hydrodemolition and priner soil inspection. Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. was formerly known as Mills SI Serviços Industriais S/A and changed its name to Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. in 2016. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Arab Tunisian Bank
Description: Arab Tunisian Bank provides various banking products and services for individuals and companies primarily in Tunisia. The company offers savings accounts; term deposits; bank cards; money transfer services; financing services; and internet and mobile banking services. It also provides abroad transfer foreign exchange transaction placement and portfolio management services. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Arab Tunisian Bank operates as a subsidiary of Arab Bank plc.

Name: Saudi Marketing Company
Description: Saudi Marketing Company engages in the retail trading and importing business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through three segments: Retail Household and Entertainment Service. The company is involved in wholesale and retail of food household utensils toys fabrics and clothing and stationery products. It also provides marketing services; operates and manages bakeries restaurants and cafes; and establishes operates and maintains entertainment centers. The company operates under the Farm Superstores name. Saudi Marketing Company was founded in 1978 and is based in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Zeda Limited
Description: Zeda Limited provides mobility solutions in South Africa and other countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through the Car Rental and Leasing segments. The Car Rental Business segment provides short-term rental and subscription solutions for individuals business travel corporates and government entities under the Avis and Budget brand name; replacement vehicles for its partner insurance companies; and other complementary products including the hire of child car seats GPS and bike racks and specialized insurance products. Its Leasing Business segment offers leasing services of vehicles such as motorcycles and heavy commercial vehicles for corporates small businesses and government entities; complementary products such as telematics intelligent fuel and accident management roadside assistance insurance and managed maintenance services; and service and maintenance plans. In addition the company sells its cars from its rental and leasing businesses to retail customers and wholesalers through dealerships wholesale outlets online channels and independent wholesalers. It also engages in the advertisement of its retail vehicles through Avis Car Sales and other third-party websites as well as the sale of wholesale stock through the Avis Auction online auction trading platform and bulk deal offerings directly to the market. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kempton Park South Africa.

Name: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Karel Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. designs develops produces and sells communication systems in Türkiye. It offers communication products such as PBX phone systems for small medium and large-scale businesses; IP based call center systems for public and private institutions; and IP analog wall hotel and feature phones as well as direct station select modules and operator phone headsets. The company also provides convergence and integration products including conference products GSM terminals wireless (DECT) systems auto-attendant and voicemail modules call traffic control systems VoIP and network products call recording systems nurse call systems and other products as well as vehicle tracking systems. In addition it offers visual communication and security systems comprising security cameras intruder alarm and intercoms; cloud solutions with Internet applications that facilitate the business processes and provide economy and productivity for corporate users; and electronics manufacturing services as well as undertakes telecommunication projects for fixed and mobile operators and state institutions and organizations. Further the company offers defense industry solutions such as military tactical switches; alarm and announcement system for small boats and navy ships phone and intercom PABX system military gateway and communications switching systems; electronic mirror; military computers; and inertial navigation systems. It provides its communication solutions for hotels public institutions medical institutions educational institutions production facilities retail business finance institutions and transportation institutions. The company also exports its products and technologies to approximately 30 countries. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Istanbul Türkiye.

Name: Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG
Description: Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in engineering contracting and construction businesses in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through four segments: Construction Manufacturing Hiring of Equipment and Training of Personnel. The company constructs a range of projects including palaces commercial establishments housing complexes educational institutions hospitals monuments religious structures stadiums showrooms telephone exchanges and residences. It also offers design civil mechanical electrical and instrumentation services for oil and gas pipelines and flow lines; construction of oil storage tanks gathering stations and compressor stations; and design and construction of power transmission systems. In addition the company constructs railway roads bridges dams seaports airports and water and wastewater transmissions; and provides operation and maintenance of water transmission networks infrastructure works of industrial parks and refineries and large- scale earthmoving projects. Further it is involved in hiring equipment; training services; engineering procurement and construction consultancy services; production and sale of ready-mix concrete products; electrical and HVAC services; and plumbing and maintenance contracts. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Jalles Machado S/A
Description: Jalles Machado S/A produces markets and exports sugar ethanol and other by-products from sugarcane. The company offers crystal and organic sugar; hydrated anhydrous industrial and organic ethanol; sanitizing products; and yeast. It also produces clean and renewable energy from cane bagasse and straw. In addition the company engages in industrial automation 4G project agro-industrial control tower and research and development activiries. Jalles Machado S/A was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Goianésia Brazil.

Name: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. acquires develops and operates beach and urban hotels in Mexico. It operates in three segments: Urban Services Resort Services and Operator and Holding. The company operates a portfolio of 27 hotels under the Krystal Grand Krystal Hotels & Resorts Krystal Beach and Krystal Urban brands as well as under licensed brands such as Hilton Hilton Resorts Hilton Garden Inn and Hampton Inn & Suites. It also operates third-party hotels. Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A.
Description: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. engages in the sale of vehicles and spare parts in Tunisia. It is also involved in the manufacture of electronic equipment comprising filters for the automotive and real estate development industries. The company was formerly known as Renault Tunisie. Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc markets and distributes refined petroleum products in Nigeria. It operates through Network General Trade and Aviation segments. The company offers premium motor spirit (PMS) automotive gasoline oil (AGO) and aviation turbine kerosene (ATK) as well as kerosene for use in lamps cooking stoves etc. It also provides range of lubricants such as automotive lubricants and industrial lubricants; engine oils for cars motorcycles tricycles and heavy-duty engines; transmission oils and brake fluids; marine oils and greases; and automotive and industrial greases under the TotalEnergies and ELF brand names. In addition the company jet fuels and aviation gasolines for the aviation industry; bitumen; and solar lamps and solar home and industrial solutions. Further it operates service stations and lubricants blending plants; provides food snacks and coffee products through Café Bonjour; and offers TotalEnergies Card for individuals and professionals as well as offers TouchPoint services to facilitate the management of mobile money services and other digital services. The company was formerly known as Total Nigeria Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc in September 2021. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing & Services.

Name: BAAN Holding Group Company
Description: BAAN Holding Group Company for Tourism and Development Company provides hospitality and entertainment services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. It operates through Hotel Entertainment and Other segments. The company operates hotels tourism health resort cafes and restaurants as well as furnished apartments entertainment and recreation centers tourist resorts commercial malls fun cities parks and gardens and related facilities. It also operates and manages electrical games hall children amusement games hall and electronic games as well as establishes and operates sports facilities projects. The company was formerly known as Abdulmohsen Al-Hokair Group and changed its name to BAAN Holding Group Company in November 2024. BAAN Holding Group Company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Libstar Holdings Limited
Description: Libstar Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and markets branded and private label consumer packaged goods in South Africa and internationally. It operates through three segments: Perishable Products Ambient Products and Household and Personal Care Products. The company offers refrigerated or frozen products including dairy convenience meals value-added meats and fresh mushrooms; wet and dry condiments meal ingredients baking and snacking and spreads; and household cleaning products as well as personal care products. It also provides baby food products; and beverages. The company sells its products under the Lancewood Millennium Foods Finlar Fine Foods Denny Mushrooms Umatie Rialto Cape Herb & Spice Khoisan Gourmet Cape Foods Montagu Foods Cecil Vinegar Dickon Hall Foods Cape Coastal Honey Chamonix Amaro Foods Cani Ambassador Foods Contactim and retailer brands to retail and wholesale food service industrial contract manufacturing and export channels. Libstar Holdings Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Plattekloof South Africa.

Name: Allied Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Allied Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes technology products in Brazil and Latin America. It engages in the wholesale and retail trade of telephone computer electronic devices accessories and peripherals. The company also provides logistics services; delivery and storage services; program development and licensing; image processing and services related to enabling data voice and recharge plans; and payment services deposit transfer and/or withdrawal of funds management of payment accounts issuance of payment instruments and others. It sells its products through digital retail including marketplaces e-commerce platforms and digital operations solutions; physical retail such as brand shops; and distribution channels. The company was formerly known as Dstar Participações S.A. and changed its name to Allied Tecnologia S.A. in November 2015. Allied Tecnologia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Ennakl Automobiles S.A.
Description: Ennakl Automobiles S.A. operates as an importer and distributor of vehicles in Tunisia. The company offers vehicle brands such as Volkswagen Volkswagen Utilities Audi Porsche SKODA SEAT CUPRA and Renault Trucks. It also sells new and used vehicles. In addition the company provides spare parts and after-sales services. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia. Ennakl Automobiles S.A. operates as a subsidiary of PGI-Holding.

Name: Combined Motor Holdings Limited
Description: Combined Motor Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the motor retail and distribution business in South Africa. It offers new and used vehicles including parts and accessories; and fleet solutions. The company also provides car rental services. In addition it offers insurance products that includes death disability dread disease and retrenchment of customers and vehicle and component warranties as well as vehicle financing. Further the company is involved in supply and installation of workshop lifting lubrication and diagnostic equipment waterless car wash systems and office consumables services. Combined Motor Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Durban South Africa.

Name: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. develops operates and manages hotels in Mexico Costa Rica Colombia and Chile. The company operates hotels under the City Junior by Marriott City Express Suites by Marriott City Express by Marriott City Express Plus by Marriott and City Centro by Marriott brands. It also provides marketing technical and administrative; real estate development; restaurant operation and catering; and IT server maintenance update and equipment rental services as well as software platforms and applications; and dashboards for hotel managers and operating teams. In addition the company develops Front2Go a property management system; hires personnel or third parties for the development of civil works; and invests in hospitality industry projects. It serves business travelers. The company was formerly known as Hoteles City Express S.A.B. de C.V. and changed its name to Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. in April 2024. Promotora de Hoteles Norte 19 S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc
Description: PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and sells various consumer products and home appliances to wholesalers in Nigeria and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Home and Personal Care Products; and Durable Electrical Appliances. The company offers detergents soaps cosmetics refrigerators freezers air-conditioners televisions generators and washing machines. The company also sells its products under the Morning Fresh Zip Canoe Premier Excel Joy Stella Venus Imperial Leather Cussons Baby Original Source Carex Robb and Haier Thermocool brands. The company was formerly known as Paterson Zochonis Industries Plc and changed its name to PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc in September 2006. The company was founded in 1899 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of PZ Cussons (Holdings) Limited.

Name: Gemfields Group Limited
Description: Gemfields Group Limited together with its subsidiaries operates as a mining company. It operates through Kagem Mining Limited Montepuez Ruby Mining Limitada Development Assets Fabergé Corporate and Other segments. The company explores for emerald beryl ruby corundum gold and allied minerals in Zambia Mozambique Ethiopia and Madagascar. It also engages in the wholesale and retail of jewelry and watches through directly operated boutiques international wholesale partners its website and other third-party online marketplaces; sale of cut and polished gemstones; and provision of marketing and technical and administrative services. In addition the company mines platinum group metals including platinum palladium rhodium and gold in South Africa. The company was formerly known as Pallinghurst Resources Limited and changed its name to Gemfields Group Limited in June 2018. Gemfields Group Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in London the United Kingdom.

Name: Delta Sugar Company
Description: Delta Sugar Company engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar beets in Egypt. It offers white and sugar cubes; beetroot pulp; and molasses for use in animal feed industry and to produce alcohol carbon dioxide converted honey vinasse and various types of baker's yeast. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Delta Sugar Company is a subsidiary of Egyptian Sugar and Integrated Industries Company SAE.

Name: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Europap Tezol Kagit Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells cleaning papers and reel paper materials in Turkey. It offers jumbo rolls napkins dispenser towel toilet papers and kitchen towels under the Softy Mare Ecco Y.D and Dolce brands as well as private label brands. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Izmir Turkey.

Name: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S.
Description: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of paper products in Turkey. The company operates through three segments: Chemical Products Paper and Other Operations. It offers paper pulp and photocopy paper. The company also provides sodium sulphate potassium sulphate salt and magnesium chloride liquid. In addition it offers Insurance intermediary services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E)
Description: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries produces and sells a range of branded generic pharmaceuticals food supplements veterinary products and nutraceuticals in Egypt. The company manufactures markets sells and stores pharmaceutical reagents for human and veterinary use and diagnostic reagents for individuals laboratories and hospitals; imports pharmaceutical reagents and raw materials; and produces food supplements for human use. It offers a portfolio of products in various therapeutic areas such as anti-biotics cardiovascular diseases and gastro-intestinal tract disorders anti-infectives alimentary tract and metabolism genito-urinary system nervous system blood forming organs weight management and sex hormones. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells bed furniture quilt armchair sofa home textile and home furniture. The company offers beds and mattresses; home textile products that include duvet covers and sets bedspreads blankets sheets and pillow cases bathroom textiles cushions and covers sofa throws and dowry sets; base and headboard sets; and home and sitting room products such as TV blanket slipper pet bed and room fragrances. It sells its products through stores. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kayseri Turkey.

Name: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries markets and distributes petroleum products primarily in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers one-stop-shop service stations that provides on- the-go shopping food and beverages; commercial fuels; fuel cards and lubricants; and digital transformation solutions. The company also provides marine fuel and solutions advertisement and property rental services. In addition it operates retail convenience store car care centers and coffee franchise. Further the company markets and distributes petroleum products and bunker petroleum products. The company was formerly known as BP Oman SAOG and changed its name to Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG in October 2003. Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1998 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the production and marketing of manganese minerals and ferroalloys in Mexico and internationally. It is also involved in the electricity generation and mining of precious metals. The company offers ferroalloy and manganese products including high medium and low carbon ferromanganese; silicomanganese; nitrided medium carbon ferromanganese; manganese nodules and carbonates; and other specialty ferroalloys as well as manganese derivatives such as battery-grade natural manganese dioxide ceramic-grade natural manganese dioxide and manganous oxide products. In addition the company generates electricity through hydroelectric plant; and produces electrolytic manganese dioxides. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in San Pedro Garza García Mexico. Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Autlán Holding SAPI de CV.

Name: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi distributes IT products in Turkey. The company’s products portfolio includes computers/tablets smartphones printers consumer electronics software peripherals wearable technologies data storage products smart home products and accessories. It purchases and sells spare parts and home electronics as well as provides logistics and rental services. Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Vittia S.A.
Description: Vittia S.A. provides fertilizers in Brazil and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Foliar Fertilizers and Industrial Products; Soil Micronutrients; Soil Conditioners and Organominerals; and Biological Products. It offers biological organomineral foliar bio and concentrated suspension fertilizers; adjuvants; biological pesticides comprising microbiological and macrobiological control; inoculants; sulfur; acaricides; soil conditioners; vegetable nutrition products consist of chloride CoMo phosphite macro nitrate soluble powders and concentrated suspensions; sulphates; and granulated micronutrients and salts for agriculture and livestock. The company was formerly known as Vittia Fertilizantes e Biológicos S.A. and changed its name to Vittia S.A. in May 2023. Vittia S.A. was founded in 1971 and is based in São Joaquim da Barra Brazil.

Name: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi
Description: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi provides electricity contracting services in Turkey. The company offers electrical contracting services for weak current systems LV electrical contract works and MV electrical contract works; and construction services. It also generates renewable energy from sun wind rain tides waves and geothermal heat. The company was formerly known as ORGE Enerji Sistemleri Insaat Metal Ticaret ve Taahhüt A.S. and changed its name to Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi in June 2010. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Takween Advanced Industries
Description: Takween Advanced Industries produces and sells plastic packaging products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the Arab Republic of Egypt and internationally. The company offers polyethylene terephthalate (PET) Preforms for bottle manufacturing in the food beverage and dairy industries; PET and HDPE bottles for dairy beverages food and personal care applications; closures; and thermoformed and In-Mold Labeling (IML) packaging solutions. It also provides shrink films for food beverage and industrial applications; PS and PP sheet rolls; plastic crates and pallets; and flexible packaging solutions include custom plastic bags for food retail and industrial applications; and specialized industrial plastic including drums Jerry cans form-fill & seal (FFS) film HDPE insulation film and greenhouse plastic rolls. In addition the company provides disposable polystyrene cups lids and other plastic related products; and non-woven fabric products. Further it engages manufacture wholesale and retail trading of plastic containers and polyethylene cups rolls and bags; and management and operation of industrial centers. Additionally the company owns land; establishes industrial institutes and provides and coordinates training courses related to the development of plastic products; and establishes manages operates and maintains various industrial projects as well as engages in the import and export wholesale and retail of plastic products. The company was formerly known as Al-Othman Plastic Products. Takween Advanced Industries was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme
Description: Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme provides leasing and factoring services in Tunisia Algeria Ivory Coast Senegal Burkina Faso Mali Cameroon Gabon Kenya Zambia and Tanzania. It provides financing solutions including auto transport building equipment medical and real estate. It also provides long term rental services. It serves liberal professions craftsmen traders and farmers. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Tunis Tunisia. Tunisie Leasing & Factoring Société anonyme is a subsidiary of Amen Bank Société anonyme.

Name: Al Omaniya Financial Services SAOG
Description: Al Omaniya Financial Services SAOG engages in the hire purchase and lease finance for motor vehicles and other assets in the Sultanate of Oman. The company provides Life Line an auto finance product for financing saloon cars and commercial vehicles facilitating hire-purchase and leasing options for new used and refinance own vehicles; and asset finance debt factoring bills discounting bridge and working capital loans and project and construction loans. It also offers loans for electronic or household products; and accepts fixed deposits from small medium and large corporate houses. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: City Cars S.A.
Description: City Cars S.A. distributes transport vehicles and spare parts under the brand of Kia in Tunisia. The company is involved in storing washing servicing and marketing of spare part accessories and transport vehicle. It also engages in purchases and sales of used vehicles and accessories. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in La Goulette Tunisia.

Name: Fidson Healthcare Plc
Description: Fidson Healthcare Plc manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical products in Nigeria. The company operates in three segments: Over-the-Counter Ethical Products and Consumer Healthcare Product. It offers drugs infusions and injectables. The company also provides products for anti infective and anti malaria central nervous system and cough and cold gastrointestinal medicines; supplements; topical/dermatological medicines; vitamins and minerals; and ophthalmic solutions. Fidson Healthcare Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A.
Description: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. operates as a multi-solution company in Brazil. The company offers private healthcare plans markets and manages other insurance or complementary services and provides services for the capture routing authorization and billing of medical and hospital services. It also offers medical audit services processing of medical bills call center operations claims and hospital network management system licensing and other outsourced healthcare support services. Additionally it engages in mass insurance brokerage through retail channels such as life insurance capitalization home insurance extended warranty financial protection insurance and others. The company facilitates client access to accredited networks of service providers and offers specialized care management services. It provides private collective healthcare plans to members of contracting legal entities offers technical support supports the human resources area in managing plan benefits outsources administrative services manages registration movements checks invoices and provides billing services to beneficiaries by delegation. It also offers consulting services and suggests plan design and management models. In addition the company identifies the target market defines the marketing strategy and distribution model and offers membership plans to potential clients through its own distribution channel or a network of accredited insurance brokers. It serves monitors and reviews client portfolios. The company was formerly known as Qualicorp S.A. and changed its name to Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. in June 2018. It was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Unilever Ghana PLC
Description: Unilever Ghana PLC manufactures and markets sells fast-moving consumer goods in Ghana. It operates through the Nutrition Home Care and Beauty & Personal Care segments. The company provides laundry and household care products; and skin cleansing skin care oral and deodorant products. It is also involved in investment management; real estate development; and manufacturing importing and exporting goods wares and merchandise. The company is headquartered in Tema Ghana. Unilever Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings Limited.

Name: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates a chain of restaurants under the BigChefs NumNum and Buselik brands in Turkey and internationally. It also franchises its restaurants. Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG
Description: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG manufactures sells and distributes glazed ceramic tiles in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers floor tiles for kitchen balcony bathroom bedroom and living room as well as for residential and commercial spaces; outdoor floor tiles; elevated wall tiles; decorative panels; and porcelain tiles under the Al Shams brand name. It exports its products in approximately 20 countries including GCC the Middle East and Africa. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: GOIL Plc
Description: GOIL Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the marketing of petroleum and other energy products and services in Ghana. It offers jet fuels fuels liquefied petroleum gas auto LP gas lubricants bitumen polymer aviation fuel and specialty products; bunkering services; marine gas oil; distributes various petroleum products including gasoline kerosene diesel marine and mining diesel and lubricants and premix fuel; and provides fuel cards. In addition the company offers electronic payments money transfers and other IT-related business; consultancy; and other support services. It operates through retail network of service stations and consumer outlets as well as lube bays. The company was formerly known as Ghana Oil Company. GOIL Plc was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: NEM Insurance Plc
Description: NEM Insurance Plc provides general insurance products and services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria and Europe. The company offers corporate insurance products such as motor marine cargo and hull aviation oil and gas engineering computer and electronics fidelity guarantee and group personal accident insurance; personal insurance products including goods in transit fire and special perils travel motor home protection professional indemnity and enhanced motor third party insurance; and SME products comprising burglary product liability fidelity guarantee motor insurance cash in transit group personal accident and agricultural insurance products. It involved in asset leasing and LPO financing activities. It offers its products to manufacturing industrial commercial enterprises and financial institutions such as banks mortgage and stock broking firms. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Unité de Fabrication des Médicaments S.A
Description: Unité de Fabrication des Médicaments S.A. develops manufactures markets and sells generic and fashioned medicines in Tunisia and internationally. The company offers ophthalmic ENT inhalation and infusion solutions injectable fluids and penicillin and cephalosporin powders for various therapeutic areas under the UNIMED brand name. It exports its products to Africa Asia and Europe. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Sousse Tunisia.

Name: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail sale of technology products in Turkey. The company sells its products through its stores; air conditioners and refrigerators through its dealer network; and solar energy systems. The company also provides e-commerce services including marketplace operations and derives rental income from investment properties. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Positivo Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Positivo Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops manufactures sells and distributes hardware software and information technology (IT) solutions in Brazil and internationally. It operates through Consumer Public Institutions and Corporate segments. The company offers computers smartphones tablets accessories smart home and environment devices office products electronic security devices servers mobile payment terminals payment machines and IT infrastructure products; education technology solutions including self-service kiosks data collection devices for demographic surveys and electronic voting machines; and medical laboratory and communication equipment. It also engages in the rental of IT and mobility (hardware as a service) equipment; provision of IT technical support and managed IT services; sale of pedagogic application systems and school administration products; technical-pedagogical planning and support; and representation sale implementation training support and technical assistance for equipment as well as for technical technological and scientific teaching systems. It serves end consumers residential condominiums businesses schools and public institutions. The company was formerly known as Positivo Informática S.A. and changed its name to Positivo Tecnologia S.A. in April 2017. Positivo Tecnologia S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Curitiba Brazil.

Name: Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C.
Description: Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C. through its subsidiaries operates in the IT and communication technology; engineering procurement and construction (EPC); consultancy; oil and gas; trading; logistics; and MEP sectors. It offers cyber security unified communication and collaboration software defined networking next generation network structured cabling low voltage cable installation fiber-optic network security wireless and mobility TETRA and AVLS solutions; a range of security and safety services for businesses governments and residences; and audio and visual solutions as well as operates as an EPC contractor for various industries including oil and gas power water and infrastructure. The company also provides centralized alarm monitoring station intrusion and burglary alarm system virtual guarding and CCTV integration central control designing maintenance technical support and alarm monitoring services as well as intrusion alarm for armoured vehicles and development/integration of centralized software. In addition it offers consultancy and human resource management services; a range of services for communications-related areas such as collaboration data centers cloud solutions information management and fully-managed managed services; and undertakes steel structural piping and related support structural and pre engineered building works as well as miscellaneous works comprising fire escape ladders fencing catwalk systems storage space gratings and chequered plates emergency stairs and balustrades gates handrails etc. Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2018 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: AIICO Insurance Plc
Description: AIICO Insurance Plc provides risk underwriting and related financial services in Nigeria. It operates through Life Insurance General Business Health Management and Asset Management segments. The life insurance segment offers whole life term assurance guaranteed pensions endowment pensions mortgage endowment savings and protection products as well as other long-term contracts. The General Business segment provides auto household commercial and business interruption insurance; and general insurance to individuals and businesses. The Health Management segment offers prepaid health plans to cater for the health needs of individuals and corporate organizations. The Asset Management segments offers portfolio management services structured investments and mutual funds for corporate and individual clients. In addition the company offers annuity property marine fire personal accident pure risk home and travel insurance as well as marine manufacturing agricultural and oil and gas insurance; and various risk plans. It markets its products through insurance brokers and agents. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Cadbury Nigeria Plc
Description: Cadbury Nigeria Plc engages in manufacturing and selling branded fast moving consumer goods in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: Refreshment Beverages Confectionery and Intermediate Cocoa Products. The Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and sells Cadbury Bournvita and Cadbury 3-in-1 Hot Chocolate. The Confectionary segment manufactures and sells Tom Tom Candy Caramel Buttermint Candy Coffee and Clorets gum products. The Intermediate Cocoa Products segment manufactures and sells cocoa powder cocoa butter cocoa liquor and cocoa cake. It offers its products through a network of distributors key accounts and institutional customers as well as chain of wholesalers and retailers. It exports its products to various countries in Africa and Europe. Cadbury Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Cadbury Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Cadbury Schweppes Overseas Limited.

Name: Dice For Ready-Made Garments (SAE)
Description: Dice For Ready-Made Garments (SAE) manufactures markets and retails ready-made garments for men women and kids in Egypt. The company offers fabric knitting fabric dyeing fabric finishing all-over fabric printing elastic draw-cord and socks production services. It also provides sleepwear casual wear and accessories through retail stores and wholesale partners. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi provides consumer electronics products in Turkey. The company offers cables adapters bags covers and similar accessory products for audio and video products. It also provides maintenance and repair services. The company distributes its products under the Apple Beats by Dr.Dre JBL Harman Kardon Thule Case Logic Marshall Urbanears and Hama Brands. Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Automob Participações S.A.
Description: Automob Participações S.A. engages in retailing trucks buses machinery and equipment in Brazil. The company is based in Cuiabá Brazil. Automob Participações S.A. is a subsidiary of Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A.

Name: South Valley Cement Company
Description: South Valley Cement Company produces and sells cement and its associated products in Egypt. The company provides Portland cement clinker Portland ordinary cement and ready-mix concrete. It also owns and manages a portfolio of multi sector direct and indirect investments. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: National Printing Company S.A.E.
Description: National Printing Company Ltd. operates converting and printing houses for consumer packaging in Egypt. It offers flexible carton or offset and corrugated packages for use in the inbox lamination books and paper cups industries. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Cairo Egypt. National Printing Company Ltd. is a subsidiary of Grandview Investments Holding Corp.

Name: Taageer Finance Company SAOG
Description: Taageer Finance Company SAOG provides financial services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers corporate deposits and issues non-convertible bonds for funding. It also provides leasing working capital finance factoring receivables new and used auto loans consumer loans and structured finance as well as insurance products to retail SME and corporate customers. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S.
Description: Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S. produces and sells tires under the Goodyear Fulda Sava Debica and Kelly brands worldwide. It offers tires for consumers; and aviation commercial truck off-the-road racing and recreational vehicle tires. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Istanbul Turkey. Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S. is a subsidiary of Goodyear S.A.

Name: Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A.
Description: Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A. provides services and products related to environmental management worldwide. The company operates through the Environment Response and Others segments. The company provides crisis management and emergency response services; industrial cleaning and repair and maintenance services; maritime services such as port support and offshore services; water production and supply and effluent management; energy generation services from waste; and waste management and decarbonization services. Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Oman United Insurance Company SAOG
Description: Oman United Insurance Company SAOG engages in the underwriting of general life and medical insurance business in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers insurance and re-insurance for motor fire general accident marine cargo hull workmen compensation engineering and aviation. The company also provides travel home personal accident jet ski boat/yacht marine transit property project marine group personal accidents machinery breakdowns electronic equipment contractor's plant and machinery professional indemnity money fidelity guarantee business travel package and medical expenses insurance. In addition it is involved in the repair and maintenance of motor vehicles. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Lojas Quero-Quero S.A.
Description: Lojas Quero-Quero S.A. engages in the general retail trade activities in Brazil. It offers construction tools home appliances cell phones decoration organization furniture garden TVs and audio small appliances bed table and bath cleaning household utilities children's fashion and lifestyle air conditioning computing sports beauty automotive musical instruments technology office and stationery agribusiness and health products. The company also provides credit card and financial services. Lojas Quero-Quero S.A. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Cachoeirinha Brazil.

Name: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc
Description: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc together with its subsidiaries underwrites risk and non-life insurance contracts in Nigeria. It operates through Non Life Business Life Business Insurance Asset Management Property development and Health Maintenance segments. The company offers life and saving products such as whole life term life cash back term life life celebration instant plan bonus life life saving education plan group life insurance; health insurance including group and employee health plans and third party administrator plan; and investments which includes money market fund equity income fund education trust employee investment scheme and customized portfolio. It also provides business insurance plan agric motor home money travel group personal accident marine fire and special peril burglary insurance fidelity liability goods-in-transit and engineering insurance. The company was formerly known as Mansard Insurance Plc and changed its name to AXA Mansard Insurance Plc in July 2015. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. AXA Mansard Insurance Plc operates as a subsidiary of Assur Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: Aluminium Du Maroc SA
Description: Aluminium Du Maroc SA together with its subsidiaries designs and manufactures aluminium alloy profiles in Morocco Côte d'Ivoire and Senegal. The company offers extrusion anodization powder coating thermal cutting and completion. It also provides industrial solutions including CAD design of customized profiles on Autocad software calculation of mechanical properties of the profile feasibility and cost analysis development of dies supply of samples prototypes manufacturing production of pre-series and large-scale production; and architectural solutions such as windows sliding windows skylights sunshades blinds curtain walls gates railings pergolas interior partitions. In addition the company engages in the production and marketing of abrasive paper; manufacturing machining and installation of aluminium joinery systems such as hyline profiles systems comfort line and nafida aluminium; aluminium frames for the building industry; aluminium hardware accessories and finishing services for aluminium profiles; trade of aluminium items; and real estate and hotel businesses. It exports its products to Europe and Africa. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tangier Morocco.

Name: Lokman Hekim Engürüsag Saglik Turizm Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhüt A.S.
Description: Lokman Hekim Engürüsag Saglik Turizm Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhüt A.S. together with its subsidiaries owns and operates hospitals in Turkey. It is also involved in designing platform to compare the content presentation form and prices of the services provided by the contracted health services; and operation of medical units. In addition the company offers insurance and brokerage services; health services; milk and livestock breeding; and laboratory services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Fan Milk PLC
Description: Fan Milk PLC produces manufactures and distributes recombined milk and other dairy products in Ghana Nigeria Côte d'Ivoire Togo and Burkina Faso. It offers frozen dairy juice dairy drinkable and spoonable and ice cream products under the FanVanille FanYogo SuperYogo FanXtra FanChoco FanDango FanJoy FanMaxx yogo FanIce VIKINGStar Goslo and Yaourt brand names. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Fan Milk PLC is a subsidiary of Fan Milk International A/S.

Name: Cornerstone Insurance Plc
Description: Cornerstone Insurance Plc together with its subsidiaries offers risk underwriting and related financial services for corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. The company operates through Non-Life Insurance Life Insurance Takaful Insurance Fin Insurance Leasing and Life Deposit Administration/Investment Contracts. It offers property-casualty and life/health insurance products. The company also provides motor vehicle aviation marine engineering all risks asset protection liability to third party oil and gas group life credit life mortgage protection term assurance wealth creation Takaful fire and burglary gadget protection goods in transit home personal accident and travel insurance products. In addition it offers leasing services; and investment products. Cornerstone Insurance Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the design urbanization construction promotion and sale of homes in Mexico. The company develops social interest middle-class middle-residential and residential housing. Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 2001 and is based in Cancun Mexico.

Name: Méliuz S.A.
Description: Méliuz S.A. together with its subsidiaries operate a virtual portal for the placement and dissemination of brands products services and other advertising and publicity materials. It operates through B2C (BusinesstoCustomers)National; and Other segments. The company offers leasing of virtual advertising space for the insertion of texts drawings and other materials as well as rental of space. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Conoil Plc
Description: Conoil Plc markets refined petroleum products and manufactures and markets lubricants household and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: White Products Lubricants and Liquefied Petroleum Gas. The White Products segment sells premium motor spirit aviation turbine kerosene dual-purpose kerosene low-pour fuel oil and automotive gasoline/grease oil. Its Lubricants segment offers transport and industrial lubricants greases process oil and bitumen. The LPG segment is involved in the trading of bulk and packed LPG cylinders and valves. The company was formerly known as National Oil and Chemical Marketing Plc and changed its name to Conoil Plc in January 2003. Conoil Plc was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Conoil Plc is a subsidiary of Conpetro Limited.
